title: Courtesy, Responses, and Leave-Taking
label: ch:greetings
canDo: I can thank someone, answer yes or no, say that things are fine, and take my leave politely in Marathi.

payoff.summary: Retrieve thanks, yes, fine, no, and gendered leave-taking in one short listening-and-speaking checkpoint, then write familiar हो without a visible model.
payoff.note: The checkpoint keeps independent writing and spoken retrieval separately observable rather than allowing one strong skill to hide another.
